data.title: 矢来美羽 · 摊位前的选择
data.description: 夜市摊位摆着两种颜色的手工饰品。美羽拿起其中一枚，认真看了看。
data.action: holding a small ornament at a market stall
data.promptProse: Strolling past festive night market stalls beneath canopies of glowing red paper lanterns, Miu pauses to examine a delicate glass wind chime ornament in her slender hand. Sizzling street food stalls, colorful festival masks, and the warm, golden holiday glow reflect in her striking heterochromatic eyes with youthful delight.
